neighbourhoods.name: Yeovil

housing: Somerset is a large rural county whose main towns are Taunton, Yeovil, Bridgwater and Frome. Older homes include stone cottages and terraces in the Mendips and south Somerset, Victorian terraces in the towns and seaside villas in Burnham-on-Sea and Minehead, with large new-build estates around Taunton and Bridgwater. The construction of Hinkley Point C has added demand for rooms and shared houses around Bridgwater. Much of the countryside is off the gas grid, and parts of the Somerset Levels flood.
checkinTips: Homes on or near the Somerset Levels: check ground floors, skirting boards, outbuildings and gardens for signs of past flooding.
Stone cottages in the Mendips, Frome and south Somerset: photograph walls inside for damp, chimney breasts, beams and the condition of any wood burner.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank and gauge level or LPG tank, and any septic tank or treatment plant cover.
Shared houses and rooms let to Hinkley Point workers around Bridgwater: photograph each room's lock, fire doors, smoke alarms and the shared kitchen.
Seaside homes in Burnham-on-Sea and Minehead: check window frames, outside paint and metal fittings for salt and wind damage.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact Somerset Council's Private Sector Housing and Enforcement Service, which inspects privately rented homes and takes action against landlords.
